g.text: Immediate Mode -- AI grading inline on submission
grading_mode comes from the database, not
from the autograder zip. The instructor can
switch an assignment between modes in the web
grading_mode is IMMEDIATE, so the entrypoint
invokes the AI component now rather than
leaving the tasks for a nightly rerun.
Immediate mode sets the same guard. An
instructor or TA re-running the autograder
later must not re-bill the LLM.
